name: security
description: Plan, run, inspect, import, and compare OMP-native security scans

subcommands.name: plan
subcommands.description: Create an immutable security scan plan

subcommands.name: scan
subcommands.description: Start a planned or newly planned native scan

subcommands.name: show
subcommands.description: Render a scan or security:// resource

subcommands.name: import
subcommands.description: Import SARIF or a Codex Security bundle

subcommands.name: export
subcommands.description: Export a canonical bundle, SARIF, or report

subcommands.name: validate
subcommands.description: Validate one finding with OMP-native tools

subcommands.name: compare
subcommands.description: Compare finding lineage across two scans

subcommands.name: disposition
subcommands.description: Set a finding disposition with rationale

name: settings
description: Open settings menu

name: setup
description: Open provider setup

subcommands.name: providers
subcommands.description: Configure sign-in and web search providers

name: plan
description: Toggle plan mode (agent plans before executing)

name: plan-review
description: Re-open the plan review for the latest plan (plan mode only)

name: vibe
description: Toggle vibe mode (direct persistent fast/good worker sessions; read-only toolset)

name: goal
description: Toggle goal mode (persistent autonomous objective for this session)

name: guided-goal
description: Have the agent interview you in chat, then set up goal mode

name: loop
description: Toggle loop mode. While enabled, the next prompt you send re-submits after every yield. Bound it with a count/duration, or gate it with `--until '<cmd>'` / `--while '<cmd>'` — the command's exit status decides whether the next iteration runs. Esc suspends the ongoing loop; /loop again to disable.

name: queue
description: Queue a message for after the agent yields

name: model
description: Switch model for this session

name: switch
description: Switch model for this session (same as Alt+P); accepts fuzzy ids, provider/id, @role, :level

name: fast
description: Toggle fast service (OpenAI service_tier=priority or ultrafast, Anthropic speed=fast, Google priority)

subcommands.name: ultra
subcommands.description: Enable Ultrafast (OpenAI API, or Codex and relay models that offer it)

name: slow
description: Toggle slow mode: flex tier on OpenAI/Google; on Anthropic, continue at low priority after the Claude session limit

subcommands.name: on
subcommands.description: Flex tier, or Anthropic low priority at the session limit (auto)

subcommands.name: off
subcommands.description: Standard service; stop Anthropic low priority

name: skillful
description: Toggle listing available skills in the system prompt (session only)

subcommands.name: on
subcommands.description: List skills in the prompt for this session

subcommands.name: off
subcommands.description: Omit the skills listing for this session

name: extended-context
description: Toggle extended context windows

subcommands.name: off
subcommands.description: Use default or standard-pricing context windows

name: computer
description: Toggle the native computer-use eval prelude for this session

subcommands.name: on
subcommands.description: Enable computer use for this session

subcommands.name: off
subcommands.description: Disable computer use for this session

name: ratchet
description: Build (or reuse) an eval for an LLM flow, then hillclimb it unattended

name: prewalk
description: Arm, restart, or cancel a one-shot model handoff

subcommands.name: restart
subcommands.description: Return to the planning model and re-arm the handoff (default prewalk.from → prewalk.into)

subcommands.name: off
subcommands.description: Cancel this session's handoff without changing the active model

name: modelpreset
description: Save and switch model presets (role models + thinking level)

subcommands.name: save
subcommands.description: Save the current role models and thinking level

name: effort
description: Set reasoning effort (thinking level, intelligence) for this session; Shift+Tab cycles levels

name: advisor
description: Toggle the advisor (a second model that reviews each turn and injects notes)

subcommands.name: dump
subcommands.description: Copy the advisor's transcript to clipboard

name: export
description: Export session to HTML file

name: trace
description: Open this session's trace in the stats dashboard

name: dump
description: Copy session transcript to clipboard (and write LLM request JSON to tmp)

subcommands.description: Write a zip with the main transcript, LLM request JSON, and one file per subagent

subcommands.name: anon
subcommands.description: Write a zip of anonymized session JSONL (contents redacted, metadata kept) plus subagents

name: share
description: Share session via an encrypted link (share server or secret gist)

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.description: List active local Collab hosts (no links; use `omp collab link`)

name: join
description: Join a shared collab session

name: leave
description: Leave the collab session

name: browser
description: Toggle browser eval-prelude headless vs visible mode

name: copy
description: Pick text or code from the conversation to copy

name: open

subcommands.description: Show every phase and task in the HUD

subcommands.description: Append a task; phase fuzzy-matched or auto-created
